claude_diagrams.input_scope: Both source texts plus five preselected Codex-origin options. Claude authored diagrams and outlines, not independent option generation.
claude_diagrams.rendering: Claude Mermaid nodes and edges parsed to DOT and locally rendered with bundled @viz-js/viz. No remote diagram runtime.
claude_diagrams.caveats: Raw response includes an illustrative 62 percent figure and rough time estimate. Neither is a measured result; neither is used as briefing data. Codex notes narrow schema and scope claims.

gemini.warning: CLI warned --mode plan has no effect while slash command expansion is disabled. Sandbox flag enabled; prompt explicitly requested no tools, inspection, code execution, browsing or edits.
gemini.input_scope: Both complete extracted plan texts and selected verified public DG_Open code excerpts. No independent Gemini browsing.
gemini.authorization: Initial full-text transfer rejected by automatic approval review. Retried only after user explicitly answered Yes, share both plans with Gemini.
gemini.review_corrections: Branching is proposed, not source Must Have. No organizer judging rubric was supplied. Full dataset is required unless Digital Green agrees otherwise. Recommended feature combination narrowed by Codex for one-day feasibility.

public_repository.provenance: Explicit hyperlink in Technical DOCX main/footnote relationships.
public_repository.target_status: User explicitly says DG_Open is not the intended target. It is retained only as document-linked background; actual application repository unconfirmed.
public_repository.inspection: Read-only static farmer-chat subtree review. No installation, runtime test, full audit or current production verification.

style: Short technical English, not certified ASD-STE100 compliance.

claude_independent_review.model: configured default; exact model not independently identified

stage_a.input_scope: Both complete source text extracts plus one-day AWS context only; no Codex proposals, briefing, or earlier model replies.
stage_a.parse_note: For display parsing only, removed one excess closing brace immediately before independent_options. Raw stdout remains unchanged.

stage_b.input_scope: Both source texts, actual completed Stage A result, original Codex five, existing briefing snapshot and explicitly attributed AWS facts from Codex checks.

claude_independent_review.sequencing: Stage A CLI returned exit 0 and full stdout before Stage B input was constructed and Stage B invoked. Separate no-session-persistence calls.
claude_independent_review.origin: C1-C5 originated with Codex. Earlier Claude diagram pass received that list. A1-A5 are the new independent Claude ideas.
claude_independent_review.verification_limits: Text-only source review. Claude did not inspect architecture image, current implementation/repository, AWS accounts, data, or judging rubric. Official AWS documentation checks were by Codex.
claude_independent_review.codex_qualification: Eligibility was already in the original baseline workflow. Claude elevated it to a separate option, not a newly missing baseline requirement.

verification.raw_output_fidelity: Both embedded PRE.textContent values exactly match actual CLI stdout bytes.
verification.input_boundary: Verifier confirmed fresh complete DOCX extraction in Stage A, no Codex/HTML context; Stage B contains full actual A and prior HTML.
verification.security: No blocking findings in separate scoped static review.
verification.scope: Briefing only, not app, AWS deployment or pilot.
